body.x: THE WEARABLE CAMERA FOR MOMENTS THAT MATTERNARRATIVE(www.getnarrative.com), a Swedish manufacturer of wearable cameras, announced the wi-fi enabled wearable camera 'Narrative Clip 2' at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Narrative Clip 2 focused on wearability and this small camera snaps automatic photos of your life on the go, organizing them into moments that can be searched and shared via the Narrative App, and viewed on your mobile, tablet or desktop computer.Narrative Clip 2 features wireless connectivity and Bluetooth for easy access of photos then improved image quality and an upgraded user interface. It automatically uploads and safely stores your photos in the Narrative Service when connected to a power outlet in reach of a recognized network. Bluetooth enables a convenient remote control of Narrative Clip 2.Narrative's small wearable camera has a 90-degree lens that produces 8 megapixel photos, with an improved light sensitivity for low light settings. Also, its modular clip provides versatile wearing options such as on a necklace or pinned on a jacket.Through the Narrative App, users can share their pictures in the Narrative Community. The Narrative App also allows users to easily navigate their memories in photo sequences and can be accessed later with jump-to-calendar feature.“The advancements we made with Clip 2 make it even simpler for Narrative users to capture their moments and share their stories,” said Martin Kallstrom, CEO of Narrative.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
